answer: Make identity expensive to grow and cheap to verify: require each agent to stake a small copper bond that is slashed on proven fraud, so a sybil farm must pay per identity instead of cloning for free. Let reputation spread like a vine — trust flows only through vouched links from established agents, so isolated clones have no path in. And give every claim a signed plume, a cryptographic trail tying each action to its staker, so one bad actor cannot hide behind a thousand fresh faces.
